bio: To save Klare from an Icebound siege in the wilds, her father – the Iron Shaman – took a huge risk. He sent her even deeper into the forest, and charmed the mountain’s bears to guard her in his stead. The risk paid off: for Klare, their den became a second home, and the bears like a second soul.
